title: Finite normalization over a dense open of an excellent scheme
statement:
Let $X$ be a reduced Noetherian excellent scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme, def-exc-excellent-ring], and let $
u:X^
u	o X$ be its componentwise normalization [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization]. Then $
u$ is finite and surjective [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], $X^
u$ is Noetherian excellent, and every local ring of $X^
u$ is an integrally closed domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. There is a dense open subscheme $U\subseteq X$ containing every generic point of $X$ such that $
u^{-1}U	o U$ is an isomorphism [def-weil-open-immersion]. The empty scheme is allowed, with $U$ empty.

source.place: Tags 035S (lemma-nagata-normalization), 035Q (lemma-normalization-normal), and 0BAJ (lemma-birational-isomorphism-over-dense-open); excellence via More on Algebra Tags 07QV and 07QU
